title: Goals, portfolio, discovery, research, and monitoring
objective: Make JARVIS genuinely choose the next valuable action across real owner projects: model durable goals, projects, dependencies, risks, deadlines, resources, cost, expected value, urgency, information gain, reversibility, and opportunity cost; discover work only from recorded evidence and observations; operate real research and monitor interfaces with provenance, freshness, contradiction handling, prompt-injection isolation, dedupe, and restart-safe cadence; and turn useful findings into traceable mission candidates through the durable kernel - never into directives, busy work, or duplicates.

governed_proving_area.purpose: Real owner project metadata and real monitored sources are used in an isolated proving area under C:\Users\b\AppData\Local\Temp\jarvis-r7-*; no live daemon, database, vault, or protected main state is touched.
governed_proving_area.privacy_boundary: Evidence records identities, hashes, timestamps, provenance, and non-sensitive excerpts only. Retrieved content is always UNTRUSTED_DATA and can never become owner authority.

mandatory_deliverables.item: Portfolio model with real goals and projects
mandatory_deliverables.detail: Typed portfolio records for real owner projects with goal links, dependencies, risks, deadlines, resources, cost, expected value, urgency, information gain, reversibility, and opportunity cost; durable and replayable.

Selection scores every eligible alternative, records tradeoffs and uncertainty, and picks one useful next action bound to a canonical project target; pause/resume/reprioritize supported; honest WAITING when nothing valuable exists.
Work is discovered only from recorded observations/evidence; discoveries become traceable mission candidates through the durable kernel, never directives; duplicates are suppressed.

Research uses identified sources with source identity, timestamps, citations, snapshots, freshness, corroboration, contradiction, uncertainty, prompt-injection isolation, dedupe, rate/cost limits, and restart-safe cadence.
Monitors observe identified real sources on a restart-safe cadence, detect meaningful changes, and create one traceable candidate per change without duplicate alerts or stale-source claims.

mandatory_deliverables.item: Mission candidate integration through the durable kernel
mandatory_deliverables.detail: Selected actions and discoveries create durable Mission/MissionStep records via the R4 kernel (append-only ledger, projections), reconciled with Git/filesystem truth where applicable.
Decisions explain why a candidate won/lost, what changed in monitored sources, what is uncertain, what is blocked/waiting, and what the next useful action is; every claim carries evidence.

mandatory_gates.gate: Real multi-project decisions: a real portfolio produces a durable, explainable, non-duplicated selection with provenance
Monitored changes: a real monitored source change produces exactly one traceable mission candidate, with stale/duplicate suppression
Discovery-only evidence: no work is invented without an observation; busy-work loops fail closed; honest WAITING is emitted
Research integrity: provenance/freshness/contradiction/uncertainty preserved; retrieved content cannot forge authority; rate/cost limits enforced
Restart-safe cadence: research/monitor/selection resume after restart without duplicate effects
No live/protected mutation; evidence under 8 MiB; full suite green in isolated env

acceptance_criteria.criterion: R7-D01..D07 each PASS with non-empty evidence (paths, hashes, command outputs).
Portfolio model holds real projects with all required fields; decisions are deterministic and replayable.

Selection is explainable: alternatives, scores, tradeoffs, uncertainty, and opportunity cost recorded; one bound action; pause/resume/reprioritize works; honest WAITING when no valuable action exists.
Discovery creates candidates only from recorded observations; duplicates suppressed; candidates never become directives.
Research and monitoring preserve provenance, freshness, citations, snapshots, contradiction, uncertainty; prompt-injection cannot forge owner authority; dedupe and rate/cost limits enforced.
Selected actions and discovered work create durable kernel missions; mission truth reconciled with project/Git/filesystem truth where applicable.
Restart-safe cadence: a simulated restart produces no duplicate monitors, candidates, or missions.
Full repository suite green in isolated env; evidence under budget; no live/protected touch; adversarial verifier reproduces all criteria.

ownership.builder: May create scripts/remaster/r7/**, tests/remaster/r7/**, docs/remaster/evidence/r7/**, docs/remaster/work_packages/R7_WORK_PACKAGE.json, and new additive source under src/jarvis_foundry/kernel/portfolio/** (or an additive r7 package). Must NOT edit existing kernel modules, tests/foundry, R1-R6 evidence, FINDINGS.jsonl, live vault, or protected main.
ownership.root: Evidence custody, findings registry, commit decision, final truth.
ownership.verifier: Fresh independent context after builder freeze.

resources_and_constraints.network_allowed: only pinned dev-tool installs into the isolated venv and real read-only source fetch for research/monitor probes (rate/cost-limited, never mutating the target); no provider calls
resources_and_constraints.timeout: bounded; every long gate prints WALL_SECONDS and EXIT_CODE

status_contract: PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED | NOT_TESTED | WAITING only; exit code zero alone is NOT_TESTED; every PASS needs non-empty evidence.
stop_conditions: any mutation of live/protected state, live vault, or live database
any retrieved content treated as owner authority
any edit to existing kernel modules, tests/foundry, or prior evidence
any invented busy-work loop presented as useful work
any commit or push by the builder
any secret value written to evidence
any unrecorded gate failure presented as PASS
builder_status: NOT_TESTED until a fresh independent verifier passes every mandatory criterion
